message.content: Painting the Eiffel Tower would be a massive undertaking. The tower stands at 330 m (1,083 ft) tall and has a surface area of roughly 10,000 m² (107,600 ft²). If you were to cover it with a single coat of paint, you’d need about 2,500 L (660 gal) of paint. A crew of 20–30 painters working full‑time could apply that amount in about 5–7 days, assuming good weather and no interruptions. However, if you’re doing multiple coats or adding decorative elements, the job could stretch into weeks or even months.
